scope: One fixed original-rule transfer screen. NOT exact proprietary-engine/spot replication, independent unseen validation or LBank manual execution evidence.

original_rules.zero_range: No signal; undefined ratios never filled with invented values.
original_rules.interpretation: Use exact published close-location formula; it is not body-adjusted wick length. Do not repair it. Spot and futures BTC-volume distributions differ.

selection: Original winner selected after twelve source hypotheses; author performance not independently reproduced and source fees unspecified. This is one candidate in a previously searched catalogue, not confirmatory proof.

data.venue: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual, not original spot or LBank
data.sha: Every consumed ZIP checked against prior verified manifest; retain CSV SHA, URLs and original checksum URLs. Verify finite OHLCV, positive prices, nonnegative BTC volume, alignment, ordering, duplicates, time gaps and funding coverage.

execution_translation.signal: Completed minute only. One position at a time. No pyramiding or opposite-entry reversal.
entry_scenarios: next minute open, ideal zero response delay
one further minute open, fixed 60-second response sensitivity
execution_translation.entry_reference_and_protection: Set source fractional SL/TP from next available reference open at specified latency. Hold those reference levels and same selected trades fixed when doubling all costs. Fill with adverse slippage; initial R is 0.0035*entry_reference. No leverage/account allocation applied.
execution_translation.intrabar: Stop first if both touched; stop gap uses worse open; favorable target gap capped at target. Evaluate entry bar. Exit at close of 25th holding bar if neither level touched. Bound timestamps to minute close, not fabricated exact hit times.
execution_translation.gaps: Do not interpolate or force-close. A missing/quarantined minute encountered before closure produces unknown outcome; suppress overlap to planned 25-minute horizon. Completed outcomes before gap retained. End-open outcomes unknown. Do not describe known-trade totals as complete calendar account return.
execution_translation.costs: Assumed fee 0.0006 each side and adverse slip 0.0002 each side; NOT verified account fee. Funding: archived Binance settlement rate times latest observed minute-open price proxy, debit only, favorable receipts ignored. Entry-time settlement excluded; exit-boundary settlement included conservatively. No native mark-price claim. Reject missing funding coverage, do not substitute zero.
execution_translation.stress: Multiply fees, adverse slippage and funding debits by two on fixed references/trade path. No source threshold tuning.

statistics.output: All closed/unknown rows; all-period and each-year gross/base/double R, PF, closed-trade drawdown R, target-first Wilson lower, stop-within-five-minute bar proxy, whole-bar MAE/MFE proxy, raw signal/accepted alarm frequency and opportunity days.
statistics.uncertainty: Fixed seed 20261020; 2000 circular daily block samples each with 7-day and 30-day blocks; ratio of resampled net R / closed count, 2.5th percentile. Conditional on known outcomes and reused data, no selection correction or native guarantee.
statistics.warning_limit: Stop-within-five-minute proxy is NOT actual urgent-warning rate. Whole exit-bar extrema may occur after exit and overstate pre-exit MAE/MFE. Manual fill, latency, exact intraminute order, TP1 actionable timing, native price/quotes remain unverified.
statistics.promotion: Fixed docs/lbank_strategy_rebuild_2026-10-20.md unchanged. Even positive exploratory screen cannot authorize deployment or start an already elapsed forward clock.

next_if_not_qualified: Preserve all years and costs, no threshold search. Continue a different primary source with closed-ledger, full-cost and execution provenance; do not repeat unchanged results.
